description: This Java source file defines a final class MockJournalPlugin that extends Akka's AsyncWriteJournal. It provides a mock implementation of journal operations such as replaying messages, reading highest sequence numbers, writing messages, and deleting messages for testing purposes. It uses Mockito to mock the journal interface and SLF4J for logging. The class is intended for testing and verification of journal interactions in Akka persistence.

classes.name: MockJournalPlugin
classes.description: A mock implementation of Akka's AsyncWriteJournal that logs invocations and forwards delete operations to a mock object for verification, used primarily in testing scenarios.

methods.name: doAsyncReplayMessages
methods.description: Logs the invocation and returns a successful Future with null; intended to simulate replaying messages.

methods.name: doAsyncReadHighestSequenceNr
methods.description: Logs the invocation and returns a successful Future with 0; simulates reading the highest sequence number.

methods.name: doAsyncWriteMessages
methods.description: Logs the message write operation and returns a Future with empty Optional exceptions, simulating successful writes.

methods.name: doAsyncDeleteMessagesTo
methods.description: Logs delete invocation and delegates to the mock. Returns a failed Future if persistenceId equals 'failDeleteMessage', a long-running Future if 'slowDelete', otherwise a successful Future.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Static method to verify that doAsyncDeleteMessagesTo was called with the specified persistenceId and toSequenceNr.
